In finally, if parent_expired is true, a TimeoutError is raised immediately without extra wait, leaving residual processes unknown and retaining the temporary root; otherwise any remaining session members are sent SIGKILL and shutil.rmtree(root) executes only when residual is empty and census succeeded.
